# Open Problems Lab

> Independent, founder-led AI-assisted problem-solving initiative founded by Zakk Easterbrook. Investigates practical, business, technical, scientific and mathematical problems. Focused on testable outcomes, appropriate evidence, reproducibility and transparent review status.

## Start here

- [Research portfolio](RESEARCH.md): candidate findings, links, proof and review status.
- [Machine-readable ledger](research/registry.json): structured research identities and limitations.
- [Research protocol](governance/RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md): evidence, novelty, corrections and review.
- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): scope and reproduction rules.
- [Citation](CITATION.cff): attribution for the initiative.

- [Problem intake](templates/PROBLEM.md): Record a founder-selected question and measurable success criteria.
- [Commercialization policy](governance/COMMERCIALIZATION.md): Review confidentiality, disclosure and potential paid products before public release.

## Research

- [OPL-001: Prefix-reversal asymptotics](research/mathematics/prefix-reversal-asymptotics/paper.md): preliminary candidate proof of the interior generation criterion and leading asymptotic coefficients. Priority and independent review unverified.
- [OPL-002: PA5](https://github.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5): published selective KV retrieval prototype; see numerical audit and stated limitations.
- [OPL-003: Adaptive Compute Barrier](https://github.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/tree/a916efe114992a5effcd05d7a8e7725867d4e650/research/adaptive-compute-barrier): preliminary minimax stopping theorem and conditional analysis of aggregate research data.

Use the original project's citations, source references and exact commit for specific claims. No DOI, priority or peer-review claim is made for this initiative.
